package fixture

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

// Named result fields are type-identical to the unnamed actorFromCtx shape.
// The former text scanner missed this exact, assignable bypass.
func badActorFromCtxNamedResults(ctx context.Context) (tenantID, actorID string, err error) {
	tenantID, err = tenant.FromContext(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	return tenantID, "actor", nil
}
